page.layout: One page of title text, centred, with no running head, page number, catchword or signature. Margins have no printed text. Stamps, a handwritten mark top right, fleurons and a digitiser watermark are not printed text.
page.notes: The handwritten "1." with a slash at the top right is manuscript and is left out. The oval stamp (Biblioteca Nazionale Roma) and the round stamp are library stamps and are left out. The three fleurons between the imprint and the date are ornaments and are left out. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right is left out. "Typog." is damaged at the g; the reading "Typ[?]g." is doubtful. The Latin lines use u for vowels and v for consonants, so the initial U of the printer's name and the name of Uldericus are read as U. "Frisiâ" and "Academiâ" are printed with a mark over the a, which is kept.
